settings.intro: Upload a finished PNG sheet. The demo rate is $0.30 per billable inch, not $0.30 for a complete sheet. Final size, price, and copies are shown after upload.

settings.accordion_1_content: Upload the finished sheet you prepared. Artwork is not nested, combined, or rearranged.
settings.accordion_2_content: $0.30 per server-confirmed billable inch, multiplied by complete copies. Maximum printable width 22.5 in; maximum length 240 in. The $0.30 catalog reference is not a complete-sheet price.
settings.accordion_3_content: Quantity repeats the entire sheet. Genuine overflow is rejected. A file over 240 inches is not split.
settings.accordion_4_content: Illustrative prices and test checkout. Nothing is physically printed or shipped. Generated illustrations are not material or durability evidence.
